subject: Florence Beatrice Smith Price
youtube_title: Little Rock Shut Her Out. The Chicago Symphony Played Her Symphony.
hook: Little Rock would not let Florence Price into the Arkansas State Music Teachers Association because of her race. On June 15, 1933, the Chicago Symphony Orchestra performed her Symphony in E Minor — the first time a major American orchestra played a Black woman’s symphonic work.
body: Florence Beatrice Smith was born in Little Rock on April 9, 1887. She later left Arkansas for Chicago. This draft uses only facts already checked in the Encyclopedia of Arkansas and BlackPast. It is an example file, not a finished post.
cta: If your people came through Little Rock, this is your history.
